recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR-core work is needed for FHIR-15962 unless Patient Care later chooses to revise the CareTeam category value set.
issue_request: FHIR-15962 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3. It asked to replace the CareTeam.category value set with LOINC v2.65 answer codes, specifically including Home and Community Based Services-focused and Public health-focused care team categories.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied in commit a3ee90b6bdf59064cd14d04c3adf616f2638e8ad (GF#15962), which changed the CareTeam example from the old internal care-team-category code system to LOINC LA27976-2 and introduced a LOINC-based ValueSet/care-team-category containing the requested codes.
additional_context: CareTeam is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to the PC work group. CareTeam.category is bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/care-team-category. The current ValueSet source directly enumerates eight LOINC concepts after the later Published FHIR-19766 / commit 63ffc078cc8b9a13a1fa99cb973c3ae8b23cfe93 correction changed the representation from LOINC concept filters to explicit concepts. Zulip discussion of the value set's zero-concept expansion concern confirms it was fixed per J#19766. The Jira resolution text's LA27978-9 appears to be a typo because LA27978-8 is the LOINC Condition-focused care team answer code and LA27978-9 was not found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed because the current authoritative CareTeam source already satisfies FHIR-15962 and preserves the later FHIR-19766 representation correction.

related_jiras.note: Later Published correction for the same CareTeam.category ValueSet; it changed the LOINC representation to explicit concepts and explains the current source shape.
Earlier CareTeam.category value set update that FHIR-15962 superseded by switching to the LOINC answer-code set.
